title: 随机采样在认知上是浅薄的：温度变化与模型多样性之间的维度差距
summary: 该研究对比了单个LLM多次随机采样（温度τ=1）与多个不同LLM集成（τ=0）在不确定性估计上的表现。通过Marchenko-Pastur随机矩阵检验发现，单模型随机采样最多只有一个维度高于噪声水平，而多模型集成则有四个特征值超过噪声阈值。这表明自一致性虽能提供准确的逐问题不确定性，但无法揭示跨问题的结构信息，只有多样化的模型集成才能揭示模型未知的知识。
summary_en: This study compares repeated stochastic sampling of a single LLM (τ=1) with an ensemble of 24 diverse LLMs (τ=0) for uncertainty estimation. Using Marchenko-Pastur random matrix test, it finds that single-model sampling yields at most one dimension above noise, while the ensemble yields four eigenvalues above the noise threshold. Self-consistency provides accurate per-question uncertainty but no cross-question structure; only a diverse ensemble reveals what the model does not know.
